changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Update vector columns from 1024 to 1536 dimensions to match Titan Embeddings model
changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_customers_embedding; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS customers_embedding_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_accounts_embedding; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS accounts_embedding_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_transactions_embedding; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS transactions_embedding_idx;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_customer_relationships_embedding; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS customer_relationships_embedding_idx;
ALTER TABLE customers ALTER COLUMN embedding TYPE vector(1536) USING embedding::text::vector;
ALTER TABLE accounts ALTER COLUMN embedding TYPE vector(1536) USING embedding::text::vector;
ALTER TABLE transactions ALTER COLUMN embedding TYPE vector(1536) USING embedding::text::vector;
ALTER TABLE customer_relationships ALTER COLUMN embedding TYPE vector(1536) USING embedding::text::vector;
CREATE INDEX ON customers USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
CREATE INDEX ON accounts USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
CREATE INDEX ON transactions USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
CREATE INDEX ON customer_relationships USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
